description: This file acts as the server entry point for a Remix-based web application, handling HTTP requests and rendering responses, including server-side rendering and bot detection.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main function to handle incoming HTTP requests, setting CORS headers, and delegating to bot or browser-specific handling functions.
